key_highlights: ASX shares fall ahead of the anticipated RBA interest rate decision amid persistent inflation concerns.
Westpac reports a $6.8B profit but models an 11% property decline as home values drop for the seventh straight month.
Economists project a sharper, longer domestic slowdown driven by rising borrowing costs and a $315B debt overhang.
Wall Street's $1.4T wipeout and looming diesel supply shortages compound broader macro recessionary risks.

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings contrasted by accelerating credit risks and nationwide housing price declines.
sectors.implications: Mortgage volume contraction, margin compression, and rising credit impairment provisions across major lenders (WBC.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Targeted junior drilling activity underway despite broader precious metals weakness and gold capitulation.
sectors.implications: Favour low-cost diversified majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) with defensive balance sheets over speculative exploration plays (GML.AX, KRR.AX, AX8.AX).

sectors.trend: Severe diesel supply tightness poses acute macroeconomic risk, alongside upward retail power price pressure as coal capacity retires.
sectors.implications: Elevated operational costs for logistics and transport; supportive structural pricing backdrop for energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX, ORG.AX).

sectors.trend: Households pull back on discretionary spend due to compounding rate hikes, spurring corporate consolidation.
sectors.implications: Pressure on traditional retailers and department stores; M&A interest emerges in discounted operators such as Rip Curl parent (KMD.AX).

sectors.trend: Consecutive monthly declines in dwelling values and soaring debt refinancing costs depress real estate valuations.
sectors.implications: Cap rate expansion, downward net tangible asset revisions, and higher funding costs for A-REITs (GMG.AX, SCG.AX, MGR.AX).

key_themes: Monetary policy headwinds and RBA tightening cycle extending economic deceleration.
Sharp housing market retrenchment impacting household wealth and bank balance sheets.
Offshore contagion from US equity pullbacks and geopolitical midterm uncertainties.
Energy security constraints and diesel shortages escalating recession vulnerabilities.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight leveraged mortgage lenders and consumer cyclicals; rotate into cash-rich defensives.
Prioritise companies with fuel surcharge pass-through mechanisms and maintain exposure to upstream energy producers.
Implement downside index hedges on ^AXJO and preserve liquidity to absorb Wall Street spillovers.
Avoid highly leveraged small-to-mid cap issuers; focus on investment-grade credits and high interest coverage ratios.

opportunities.rationale: Defensive cash flows and low-cost curves insulate capital from cyclical domestic downturns.

opportunities.recommendation: Exploit retail M&A and special situation value
opportunities.rationale: Depressed valuations attract strategic foreign buyers, as evidenced by takeover discussions for KMD Brands.

opportunities.recommendation: Long domestic energy infrastructure and producers
opportunities.rationale: Structural shortages and power grid transition bottlenecks sustain elevated realized prices.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail mortgage-heavy banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Projected double-digit home value declines and consecutive monthly falls elevate credit provisioning risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement broad market hedges on ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Pre-RBA risk aversion combined with Wall Street volatility threatens local equity benchmark levels.

market_outlook.short_term: 1–3 month outlook remains cautious with the ASX 200 (^AXJO) pressured by imminent RBA rate hikes, housing contraction, and Wall Street volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month horizon offers selective value once policy rates peak, inflation normalises, and commodity export demand stabilizes.
key_catalysts: RBA Board cash rate decision and updated monetary policy statement
National and capital city monthly CoreLogic dwelling value releases
Domestic quarterly inflation (CPI) and wage price index updates
US midterm election outcomes and Federal Reserve policy tone
Resolution of critical diesel import logistics and refinery supplies
watch_list: Major bank net interest margins and 90+ day arrears (WBC.AX, CBA.AX)
Refined product and diesel crack spreads
Iron ore 62% Fe CFR China and spot gold prices
